THE SIKH GURDWARAS (SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1925
THE SIKH GURDWARAS (SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1925
ACT NO. XXIV of 1925
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, 1925, Pt. V, p. 216.)
[11th September, 1925]
An Act to supplement certain provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925
WHEREAS it is expedient to
supplement, (The words and comma "by legislation in the Indian Legislature,"
omitted by the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951 (26 of 1951),
s. 3 and 2nd Sch.)* * * certain
provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925, for the purposes herein after
appearing ; It is hereby enacted as follows, Punjab Act VIII of 1925. :‑
1. Short title and commencement. ‑(1) This Act may be called
the Sikh Gurdwaras (Supplementary) Act, 1925.
(2) It shall come into force on
the date (The
1st November, 1925 ; see Punjab Gazette 1925, Pt. I, p, 712.)appointed by the (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "L.
G.") [Provincial
Government] under sub‑section (3) of section 1 of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act,
1925, Punjab Act VIII of 1925.

2. Validation of certain provisions of Punjab Act VIII of 1925. The
Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925 (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), shall, so
far as it adds to or takes from the juris diction of the High Court (The words of
Judicature omitted by a.O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch.)* * at Lahore or prescribes the procedure of the said Court, be as
valid as if it had been passed by the (Subs. by the Federal Laws (Revision and Deleration) Act, 1951
(26 of 1951), s. 4 and Third Sch., for Indian Legislature. ) [Central Legislature].

Rep. by the Repealing Act, 1938 (I of 1938), s. 2 and Sch.
